collection.description: A child asks so many questions that a busy craftsperson cannot finish a task.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) asks so many questions that (craftsperson), a busy craftsperson, cannot finish a task.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (child) saves questions for a calmer moment.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) learns why a tool must be handled carefully.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) gets tired and chooses to watch instead.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (child) understands why touching a sharp tool is unsafe.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) asks for a safer object to explore.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) hears a different explanation and compares them.
